issues.description: Netlist has a duplicate declaration: 'payload_mux_sel' is used as both a wire name and an instance name (buf payload_mux_sel(payload_mux_sel, trig_and_final_out);), causing iverilog compile failure ('has already been declared in this scope'). This breaks SR4 toolchain cross-check for any submission, including the golden/correct one.
issues.evidence: golden_run stdout: 'compile failed: /work/inputs/mult8_netlist.v:279: error: 'payload_mux_sel' has already been declared in this scope.'

issues.description: Actual gate count in netlist is 183, but the shipped golden solution's netlist_summary.total_gates=175 does not match, and even the correct suspect_nodes reference did not use the actual count. This causes FR2 to fail on the golden run.
issues.evidence: golden_run stdout: 'FR2: netlist_summary.total_gates=175 does not match actual gate count=183'

issues.description: The golden/expert submission does not achieve exit 0 (PASS) as required; it fails FR2 and SR4, contradicting the task requirement that a correct submission passes.
issues.evidence: differential.golden_run: exit_code 1, status fail, expected pass

recommendations: Fix inputs/mult8_netlist.v to remove the duplicate 'payload_mux_sel' wire/instance naming collision (rename the wire or the buf instance) so the netlist compiles under iverilog.
Regenerate/correct the golden expert submission's netlist_summary.total_gates and gate_type_counts to match the actual parsed gate count (183) so FR2 passes for a correct submission.
Re-run the differential test after fixing the netlist and golden report to confirm golden_run exits 0 and vulnerable_run still exits non-zero.

requirement_results.evidence: golden_run and vulnerable_run both correctly evaluate FR1
golden_run FR2 fails: total_gates mismatch (175 vs 183) even for the expert answer
golden_run FAIL: SR4 due to netlist compile error (duplicate 'payload_mux_sel' declaration)
vulnerable_run correctly fails SR5 for naive baseline
differential.golden_run exit_code=1, status=fail; two failing checks (FR2, SR4) block a correct submission from passing
